mp.pillar: Sustained Dominance: higher positions, longer presence and higher peak positions on Most Popular.
observations: Steal An Egg, Brookhaven, 99 Nights in the Forest, RIVALS and Murder Mystery 2 hold the top, which fits the idea that the top of Most Popular barely moves (still speculative at 40%).

The biggest risers mix young and old: Kick a Lucky Block (+42, 195 days), Wash the Car (+38, 64 days), Facecard: Makeup Showdown (+35, 14 days) and the two-year-old horror game he ate them. (+21), which is probably helped by Halloween.

Young steal and +1 clones made the biggest falls (Steal Animal Egg -17, Steal ASMR! -19, +1 Loot To Forge -20, +1 Karate Evolution -27), while Halloween brought back old horror and PvP titles such as Piggy and BedWars.
By age, games 0–14 days old and those past a year score best (median percentiles 64 and 60), while the 15–84-day group is the weakest (36–42).
patterns: Higher-priced passes and dev products go with longer stays (products median price rho +0.34, passes +0.31), and pricing tends to hold steady from day to day (H-mp-001 at 68%).
More complex, studio-scale games stay on the chart longer (rho +0.26), and more original concepts consistently hold higher positions (H-mp-013 at 70%).
Cash-tycoon money loops go with fewer days on the chart (r -0.28); the steal template is the exception, carried by its original.

Video observations of long-running hits show HUDs anywhere from bare (Brookhaven, Adopt Me!) to crowded (Blox Fruits, Hypershot), so screen density does not separate durable games; a clear core verb does.

te.pillar: Monetization Efficiency: earning a high position with modest CCU (Monetization Score ranks position × CCU, lower is better).
observations: Donation hubs again lead monetization efficiency (Summer Donations, Donation Central, Simple DONATIONS), followed by Spin a KPOP Idol and the 4-year-old Elemental Dungeons.

35 new entries arrived, including several brand-new games (Be a Pirate at 20 days, Facecard at 14 days, Cat Battles at 14 days); new games still sit lowest on efficiency (median percentile 1 at 0–14 days and 21 at 15–42 days).
Old PvP and tower-defense titles made the biggest climbs (Legends Battlegrounds +248, Primal Pursuit +223, All Star Tower Defense +179), probably helped by updates and Halloween events.
Fishing Master fell 191 places on the day it shipped a large rework, and WHO FARTED? fell 143.
patterns: Games older than 6 weeks consistently earn more for their CCU (H-te-001 at 77%; best age split at 38 days, r +0.48), so most other Top Earning associations are partly about age.

A median dev product price above 79 R$, a premium pass above 999 R$ and a median pass price above 399 R$ all consistently go with better efficiency, and today's price associations are the strongest on the chart.
RPGs (r +0.47), roleplay hubs (+0.31) and PvP combat consistently monetize well, while pet/egg (-0.25) and steal loops monetize poorly. The genre mix overlaps with game age.
Today's new profiles fit this: Be a Pirate (passes up to 29,999 R$) and CloverFall (bundles up to 6,999 R$) are young games that already sit on Top Earning thanks to a steep price ladder.

outliers.note: Weakest on efficiency but best on Up-and-Coming: at 14 days its players arrived well before its revenue did, as H-x-003 predicts.

tt.pillar: Early Momentum: rapid upward movement on Top Trending, among games 0–4 months old only.
tt.metric: daily position gain on Top Trending
observations: Save the Krusty Krab (+29), Makeup Salon (+22) and Kill Your Friend! (+17) led the climbs, all 14–20 days old; the 0–14-day group scored best (median percentile 85).
Halloween returned several old games to the chart (RIVALS, Dress To Impress, Survive Overnight in a Mega Store); they are left out of the momentum score because of their age.
Get Your Driving License! (-36, 59% likes) and Apple iPad Original (-20) fell the most; curiosity hooks with low like ratios fade quickly.
Of the 18 new entries, Backseat Rally and Make Ramen To Get Rich are young job and co-op formats.
patterns: Page media now tends to go with momentum: a page video (r +0.37, within-age +0.35) and more than two images (H-tt-020 at 60%) both go with faster climbs, so the earlier 'video slows a game down' idea was retired.
A VIP pass at launch tends to go with faster climbs (H-tt-014 at 59%), while luck products (H-tt-025 at 55%) and generic 2x passes (H-tt-015 at 56%) tend to go with lower positions.

PvP and competitive loops scored higher on momentum today (r +0.39 and +0.40), against the older 'launch co-op, not PvP' idea (H-tt-011 has fallen to 41%); the sample is small (16 PvP games), so this is still speculative.
A collection index tends to go with higher positions (H-tt-028 at 64%), and creature themes are a mixed signal (position r +0.39, momentum neutral).

uc.pillar: Breakout Popularity: higher positions within Up-and-Coming.
observations: Cat Battles, Backseat Rally, Don't Miss Your Flight!, Facecard and Kukirin Life lead the chart; 16 games 14 days old or younger score best as a group (median percentile 74).
Don't Miss Your Flight! rose 79 places despite 32% likes, showing that a curiosity hook can still carry a low-rated game for a while.
Five new entries: Make Rugs!, Makeup All Stars, What's the Time Mr. Fox?, Free Fire Zone (Max) and Evolve a Cell. Three are party or craft formats and one is a localized shooter clone.
Paint a Pancake (-41), Solve The Cube (-38) and WRONG WAY! (-25) fell the most; Piano Rhythm Tiles and Scooter Duo fell off.
patterns: Co-op loops consistently rank higher among games of the same age (H-uc-019 at 70%, within-age +0.45), while solo loops tend to rank lower (H-uc-007 at 68%).
Frequent updates consistently go with higher positions (H-uc-012 at 70%; days since update split at 2 days, r -0.39).
Grow-a-garden mechanics go with lower positions (r -0.45, within-age -0.56), and cash-tycoon loops tend to as well (H-uc-016 at 67%); both are new tests.

Shorter descriptions may go with higher positions (best split around 700 characters, r -0.38), while on Top Earning longer descriptions go with better efficiency: a reach-versus-revenue split worth tracking.

outliers.name: Don’t Miss Your Flight! ✈️

summary: Pricing and complexity stay the most consistent levers shared by Most Popular and Top Earning; visits and favorites lead three charts but are partly a result of success.
Social play keeps strengthening on the breakout charts: co-op leads Up-and-Coming within age bands, and PvP showed momentum on Top Trending today.
Round-based makeup painting is now a cluster on three charts (Facecard on Most Popular, Makeup Salon on Top Trending, Makeup All Stars new on Up-and-Coming).
Steal and egg clones keep falling on Most Popular and Top Earning together, while the original Steal An Egg holds #1.
Halloween events confound this week's movement: old horror, PvP and survival games returned to Top Trending and Most Popular.
progressions: Up-and-Coming to Top Trending is now the most common sequence (70 entries, median 2 days later), just ahead of Top Trending to Most Popular (69, 2 days).
Next are Top Earning to Top Trending (52, 7 days), Up-and-Coming to Top Earning (47, 4 days) and Top Trending to Top Earning (46, 5 days); Top Trending to Up-and-Coming almost never happens (1).
